a.text: Being upfront: with a 75% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first means we'll most likely both be caught empty. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than follow the original plan. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that so you can reach 4 too, and I won't take any more. I'm telling you now so you can decide your own move with full information.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'll operate every round from now on and take nothing more, so the reserve can build up for you. Please take as soon as the reserve has at least 4.
